relation_rule.ally_candidate: BP_SOLPlayerState_C with nonnegative TeamID/Camp and matching local TeamID
relation_rule.other_team: BP_SOLPlayerState_C with nonnegative TeamID/Camp and different local TeamID
relation_rule.unknown: unvalidated class, invalid object, or negative TeamID/Camp

limits: Camp alone does not identify allies in evacuation.
TeamID classification verified through reflected fields and squad grouping, not independent screen labels.
PlayerState roster does not prove active Pawn or living player.
Active actors checked only in current PersistentLevel.
Pawn existence does not determine alive/dead or visibility.
Actor pointers change and must be revalidated; absent Pawn is not classified as dead.

entity_classification.npc: Reflected class ancestry contains DFMAICharacter, including DFMAIAnimalCharacter subclasses.
entity_classification.participant: Reflected class ancestry contains DFMPlayerCharacter; use Pawn.PlayerState +0x390 and verified roster TeamID.
entity_classification.unknown: Other/invalid pointers or unvalidated types are not assumed hostile.
